fee_notes: Fee is $8,125 per subterritory. Minimum purchase is 8 subterritories ($65,000 total); 12 subterritories costs $97,500. Fee is payable in lump sum at signing. Franchisor reserves the right to charge higher or lower fees based on market conditions, demographics, or development incentives. Installment payments may be allowed at franchisor's discretion. In 2024, one franchise sold to an existing franchisee for $56,875 (deferred); existing franchisees paid expansion fees ranging from $2,000 to $25,000. A separate non-refundable Initial Marketing Expense of $25,000 is also required at signing.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee is $8,125 per subterritory. We require a minimum purchase of eight subterritories, for a total minimum initial franchise fee of $65,000. If your Franchised Business has twelve subterritories, the initial franchise fee will be $97,500. The initial franchise fee is payable to us in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
